Infleqtion and Riverlane have signed a memorandum of understanding in the United Kingdom to accelerate research into quantum error correction and fault‑tolerant computing.  The partnership will combine Infleqtion’s expertise in quantum software with Riverlane’s hardware focus to develop more robust quantum systems.  This collaboration supports the UK’s broader strategy to strengthen its position in the emerging quantum technology sector.
